rows.ARS:
Deep pink Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Pride of Scotland
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1991).
Introduced in New Zealand by Matthews Nurseries Ltd. in circa 2003 as 'Massey University'.
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 2004 as 'Pride of Scotland'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink, ages to salmon-pink . Salmon-orange. None to mild, sweet fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, armed with thorns / prickles, bushy, upright. Large, matte, medium green foliage.

Height: 42" to 4' (105 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden.
rows.Breeder's notes: Massey University - Macwhitba. Nicknamed Whitley Bay
rows.Notes: Massey University now has a rose that carries its name, a hybrid tea bred for the University’s 75th anniversary by Dr Sam McGredy.

colour: Deep pink, ages to salmon-pink . Salmon-orange.
